CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_purchase_invoice(p_invoice_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    v_invoice public.purchase_invoices%rowtype;
    v_item record;

    v_subtotal numeric(20,4);
    v_total numeric(20,4);
    v_invoice_total_base numeric(20,4);

    v_line_total_base numeric(20,4);
    v_unit_cost_base numeric(20,8);

    v_allocated_base numeric(20,4) := 0;
begin

    if not public.is_app_owner() then
        raise exception 'Access denied';
    end if;


    select *
    into v_invoice
    from public.purchase_invoices
    where id = p_invoice_id
    for update;


    if not found then
        raise exception 'Invoice not found';
    end if;


    if v_invoice.status <> 'draft' then
        raise exception
            'Only draft invoices can be posted';
    end if;


    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.purchase_invoice_items
        where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
    ) then
        raise exception
            'Invoice must contain at least one item';
    end if;


    select
        coalesce(sum(line_total_original), 0)
    into v_subtotal
    from public.purchase_invoice_items
    where invoice_id = p_invoice_id;


    v_total :=
        v_subtotal
        - v_invoice.discount_original
        + v_invoice.tax_original;


    if v_total < 0 then
        raise exception
            'Invoice total cannot be negative';
    end if;


    if v_subtotal = 0 and v_total <> 0 then
        raise exception
            'Cannot allocate invoice discount/tax because subtotal is zero';
    end if;


    v_invoice_total_base :=
        round(
            v_total * v_invoice.exchange_rate_to_base,
            4
        );


    update public.purchase_invoices
    set
        subtotal_original = v_subtotal,
        total_original = v_total
    where id = p_invoice_id;


    for v_item in

        select
            pii.*,
            row_number() over (
                order by pii.id
            ) as row_number_value,

            count(*) over () as row_count_value

        from public.purchase_invoice_items pii
        where pii.invoice_id = p_invoice_id
        order by pii.id

    loop

        if v_subtotal = 0 then

            v_line_total_base := 0;

        elsif v_item.row_number_value
              < v_item.row_count_value then

            v_line_total_base :=
                round(
                    (
                        v_item.line_total_original
                        / v_subtotal
                    )
                    * v_invoice_total_base,
                    4
                );

        else

            -- آخر بند يأخذ فرق التقريب
            -- لضمان تطابق مجموع المواد مع الفاتورة 100%
            v_line_total_base :=
                v_invoice_total_base
                - v_allocated_base;

        end if;


        v_allocated_base :=
            v_allocated_base
            + v_line_total_base;


        v_unit_cost_base :=
            case
                when v_item.quantity_base > 0
                then
                    v_line_total_base
                    / v_item.quantity_base
                else 0
            end;


        update public.purchase_invoice_items
        set
            line_total_base =
                v_line_total_base,

            unit_cost_base_per_base_unit =
                v_unit_cost_base

        where id = v_item.id;


        -- إضافة الكمية للمخزون
        perform public.record_inventory_movement(
            v_item.material_id,
            'purchase',
            v_item.quantity_base,
            v_unit_cost_base,
            v_invoice.occurred_at,
            'purchase_invoice',
            p_invoice_id,
            v_item.id,
            'Purchase invoice'
        );


        -- آخر سعر وتكلفة للمادة
        update public.materials
        set
            last_purchase_price_original =
                v_item.unit_price_original,

            last_purchase_currency_code =
                v_invoice.currency_code,

            last_purchase_unit_id =
                v_item.purchase_unit_id,

            last_purchase_exchange_rate =
                v_invoice.exchange_rate_to_base,

            last_purchase_unit_cost_base =
                v_unit_cost_base,

            last_purchase_at =
                v_invoice.occurred_at

        where id = v_item.material_id;


        -- علاقة المادة بالمورد
        insert into public.supplier_materials (
            supplier_id,
            material_id,
            default_purchase_unit_id,
            last_price_original,
            last_currency_code,
            last_exchange_rate,
            last_unit_cost_base,
            last_purchase_at,
            purchase_count
        )
        values (
            v_invoice.supplier_id,
            v_item.material_id,
            v_item.purchase_unit_id,
            v_item.unit_price_original,
            v_invoice.currency_code,
            v_invoice.exchange_rate_to_base,
            v_unit_cost_base,
            v_invoice.occurred_at,
            1
        )

        on conflict (
            supplier_id,
            material_id
        )

        do update set

            default_purchase_unit_id =
                excluded.default_purchase_unit_id,

            last_price_original =
                excluded.last_price_original,

            last_currency_code =
                excluded.last_currency_code,

            last_exchange_rate =
                excluded.last_exchange_rate,

            last_unit_cost_base =
                excluded.last_unit_cost_base,

            last_purchase_at =
                excluded.last_purchase_at,

            purchase_count =
                public.supplier_materials.purchase_count + 1;

    end loop;


    update public.purchase_invoices
    set
        status = 'posted',
        posted_at = now()
    where id = p_invoice_id;

end;
$function$
